question: Is the repeated Flight Day 6 A-B-A activity pattern consistent with a partial per-frame human override layered on timestamp-derived plan labels?
terminal_objective: Identify the strongest supported mechanism for the action-facet fractures without converting circumstantial alignment into an edit-history claim.
method: Triangulate the repeated metadata signature against official label-generation rules, target-tag rules, requested timing, contemporaneous audio, and NASA's as-executed timeline description
authority: Read-only public-source evidence and private local repository updates only. No image pixels, publication, outreach, source correction, scientific acceptance, or claim of inaccessible edit history.

transcript_cues: Now I'm looking down the Terminator.
this was so worth the trip

mechanism_states.verified: A timestamp-to-plan pathway and a human-override pathway are both officially documented; target tags are manual and subset-only. The repeated metadata signature and contemporaneous context reproduce exactly.
mechanism_states.supported_inference: A partial per-frame curation pass is the strongest current explanation: selected 0 and +2 exposures jointly received Discussion #4 plus Terminator, while every intervening -2 exposure retained Crew Choice and no target. This is an inference from alignment, not a recovered edit log.
alternative_explanations: An undocumented automated rule produced the same exposure-position pattern.
The final LTP timing differed materially from the archived request timing.
One or more source-label defects coincidentally mimic a partial override pass.
mechanism_states.decision_use: Treat activity_id as a mixed provenance field—planned-by-time unless selectively reinterpreted—not as a uniform ground-truth class. Reconstruct actions and preserve target-presence state at plan/execution transitions.

claim_ceiling: Stage 10F may establish the official two-path activity-label procedure, the exact repeated activity/target/exposure-position association, and contemporaneous plan/execution context. It may rank partial per-frame curation as the strongest supported explanation. It cannot prove which records were human-overridden, identify correct labels, infer image content, assert that missing target always means default labeling, assign causality to scalar schema, or generalize one mechanism to every fracture without edit logs.

next_step_logic.if_alignment_fails: Retire the partial-override explanation and preserve only the verified retrieval-unit mismatch.
next_step_logic.if_alignment_holds_without_edit_logs: Use the mechanism only as a ranked explanation and test its distinct prediction: activity and target changes should remain coupled across representations and other structured fracture clusters.
next_step_logic.if_authoritative_edit_logs_appear: Replace inference with direct provenance and reclassify each fracture by generation path.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: Archive-generation logs, revised labels, final LTP timing evidence, or a counterexample where activity changes without the predicted curation coupling.
